From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

River in New Zealand
Rotokakahi River
Location
CountryNew Zealand
Physical characteristics
Source 
 • locationMaungataniwha Range
Mouth 
 • location
Whangape Harbour
Length28 km (17 mi)

The Rotokakahi River is a river of the Northland Region of New Zealand's North Island. Its winding course is predominantly southwestward from its origins in the Maungataniwha Range. It reaches the Tasman Sea 25 kilometres (16 mi) south of Kaitaia, and its estuary forms one of the two arms of Whangape Harbour (the other being the estuary of the Awaroa River).
